## Parts

- Antenna Mount: Options include roof rail, door jamb/taillight area, hood/trunk, or mirror mount. [t158]
- CB Radio: Examples: Cobra Ultra 19, Midland 75-822 [t158]
- Coaxial Cable: Length varies based on setup; 4' to 18' common. [t158]

## Tips & gotchas

- Window mounts may struggle with aftermarket window tint. [t158]
- [Partial] Roof rail mounting avoids drilling holes in the roof but requires a specific mount design or adapter. [t158]
- Door jamb/taillight mounts are popular for low-profile looks inside the cabin. [t158]
